title: sdd.comet.classic.extension.v1
description: Typed declaration of ONE managed-delivery gate extension for the Comet 0.5.0 classic-full composition application (ADR-0022). The compiler-shaped subset (id/skillId/artifactRefs/validator/afterStep) must stay byte-equivalent to the entry in integrations/comet/application/composition.json; the typed fields here carry the audit semantics (gate identity, artifact typing, judgment owner). Validated by test/delivery-cases/2_4.mjs against the real composition and the pristine upstream constraints.

id.description: Must satisfy the upstream extension identity regex read from pristine domains/comet-classic/classic-application.ts (createClassicApplication).

afterStep.description: Must be a member of the upstream checkpoint whitelist for profile=full (pristine classic-application.ts checkpoints set).

skillId.description: Executing skill of the extension step; must be a packaged asset in integrations/comet/application/skills (P1_6 manifest).

ref.description: Project-relative, non-absolute, no '..' segments — the upstream artifactRef constraint (pristine classic-application.ts).

contract.description: P2_4-r3 B-③: a diverging rewrite of the static ref for unchanged evidence is refused fail-closed by the packaged validators.

verdictProtocol.description: The extension result protocol is enforced by the upstream domain wrapper before our validator runs; declared here for audit, implemented by upstream (classic-application.ts L285-L369).

judgment.description: Names the pure component that owns the verdict logic; the extension declaration itself must carry no verdict computation.
